title: Design System: KG Knallköpp Golkrath Arbeitsplan

differences: Body 16px (parent 15px); buttons 15px semibold (parent 13px) for older members' legibility.
Sticky header with crest, wordmark and nav kept (parent removed its nav).
Dark tokens defined in globals.css .dark but no toggle or provider applies them.

display.purpose: Page h1 (Veranstaltungen, Meine Aufgaben, event title); 48px mobile, 44px for event title on mobile.

panel-title.purpose: Empty states, next-duty heading, every dialog and alert-dialog title; shift names 30/34px.

date-large.purpose: Event header and next-duty day numeral; 56px mobile.

title.purpose: Task and event titles (event rows 18px mobile).

lead.purpose: Intros, descriptions, sheet names, empty states.

meta.purpose: Times, open-spot sentences, toasts, menu and select items, alerts, form validation messages.

label.purpose: Uppercase date parts, tally status, 'du' tag. Floor size.

focus.purpose: Single global :focus-visible rule for every control.

rules.name: claim-stroke
rules.purpose: Claim line, claim panel, next-duty panel, quick-add shift row.

rules.name: quiet-line
rules.purpose: Unclaimed lines after the claim line.

rules.name: sheet-top-rule
rules.purpose: Opens every task sheet, each shift on the organizer gaps, helper and Planen lists, and the Alle Helfer table.

rules.name: pane-tab-bar
rules.purpose: Active underline tab in the organizer pane.

motion.name: claim
motion.purpose: A freshly claimed line glows then settles to pale.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: reveal 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; opacity 0 + translateY(-4px) -> none

motion.name: color-transition
motion.purpose: Button and link hover color changes.

motion.name: shimmer
motion.value: shimmer 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; linear-gradient(90deg, #eef2ea 25%, #f7f9f4 45%, #eef2ea 65%) at 220% width, background-position 100% -> -100%
motion.purpose: Sheen sweeping across loading placeholder bars.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Placeholders appear only after 150ms so fast loads never flash.

layout.eventRail: 280px, sticky top 96px from md; 40px gap to pane; native select on phones
layout.helperListColumns: stacked on phones; from sm minmax(0,3fr) minmax(0,2.4fr) minmax(0,3fr) auto
layout.quickAdd: Planen only. Task row sm: 1fr 136px 110px auto; shift row sm: 1fr 136px 136px auto; gap 12px; label-to-field 10px; stacked on phones
layout.planView: shifts 40px apart; quick-add shift after a 1px rule with 24px top padding
layout.formPage: FormPageShell: centered 672px (max-w-2xl) column; back link, 44/56px display title, optional 17px muted context, form panel 32px below
layout.cockpitHeader: h1 'Organisation' with outline 'Alle Helfer' and primary 'Neue Veranstaltung' on the right; pane actions Arbeitsplan öffnen, Bearbeiten, Duplizieren (small outline); tabs Lücken, Helferliste, Planen

overlays.dialog: width calc(100% - 2rem), max-width 512px, radius 12px, padding 24px / 32px from md, left-aligned header
overlays.menu: radius 5px, padding 4px; items 15px, padding 10px 12px, radius 3px, highlight var(--accent) / var(--accent-foreground)
overlays.motion: fade + zoom-in-95, ~200ms; sheets slide from their edge

print.hidden: header, footer, event rail, picker, tabs, all actions
print.pane: event name with date as text; shifts and tasks avoid page breaks; green text turns ink; every open spot prints as a blank 'frei' line

export.csv: semicolon-separated, every field quoted, CRLF, UTF-8 BOM (German Excel)

knownDrift: Event rail status, the phone Helferliste secondary line and Alle Helfer pagination text use 14px (text-sm), below the 15px reading floor.
'Filter zurücksetzen' (Alle Helfer) and EditButton use the secondary button variant, a resting pale fill on things that are not the viewer's own.
Skeleton shimmer colors (#eef2ea, #f7f9f4) are hard-coded in the .skeleton utility rather than :root tokens.
DashboardSkeleton still draws a 144px full-width bar (h-36) where the removed recruiting panel used to sit, so the placeholder no longer mirrors the pane.
The sign-in email's fallback-link text and footer are 14px, below the 15px reading floor.
Dashboard 'Zurück zu den Veranstaltungen' (Alle Helfer view) uses a typed '←' glyph instead of an icon.

loading.utility: .skeleton in src/app/globals.css: block, radius 5px (--radius-md), shimmer gradient, settle fade-in
loading.reducedMotion: global override leaves the bars static
loading.skeletons: src/components/layout/Skeletons.tsx: EventsPageSkeleton, EventPlanSkeleton (wash shift rail, self-start; dashed sheet lines ending in a claim-line bar), MyTasksSkeleton, DashboardSkeleton, FormPageSkeleton; one loading.tsx per route
loading.header: crest and wordmark render statically; SessionNavPlaceholder holds three 16px bars (112/112/64px) on desktop and a 44px menu-button bar on phones
loading.a11y: role="status" aria-busy with a German aria-label; bars aria-hidden

email.construction: nested role=presentation tables, inline styles, bgcolor attributes; meta color-scheme and supported-color-schemes: light
email.font: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif only; Arial bold deliberately substitutes for Barlow Condensed (mail clients can't load the display face)
email.frame: wash canvas, 32px 16px outer padding, 560px max column; header 52px crest + wordmark (12px bold muted club line, 24px/28px bold green 'Arbeitsplan', -0.5px)
email.card: white, 1px line border, 12px radius, 32px 28px padding; h1 28px/32px bold ink; lead 17px/26px ink
email.button: table-cell bulletproof button: td bgcolor club green, 6px radius; link 17px/20px bold white, padding 15px 30px
email.after: 15px muted validity line ('15 Minuten' bold ink); 1px line rule then fallback raw link in green underline; muted footer
email.extras: hidden preheader; plain-text alternative with the same copy

narrative.overview:
The Arbeitsplan is a member of the kg-eventplan "Vereinskalender" family (`~/projects/kg-eventplan/DESIGN.md`). It uses the same club green on white, the same green-tinted neutrals, Barlow Condensed Bold for dates and headings, Arial for reading text, and the same flat surfaces. Its own expression is the club's paper sign-up sheet pinned to the noticeboard. Each task is a ruled sheet with one numbered line per helper needed. Filled lines show who is coming. The first empty line is a green-outlined row, and it is the main action on the page.

Organizers get the same sheet seen from the Vorstand's side: an event folder. A wash rail lists the events by date, and the pane shows one event's gaps first, its full helper list ready to print, and a "Planen" view where shifts and tasks are added one line at a time. Counts stay in the display face, and every list keeps the sheet's ruled lines. All creation lives in this folder; the helpers' pages only link into it.

The density is generous on purpose. The users include older members on phones, so body text is 16px, lead text 17px, buttons 15px semibold and every control is at least 44px tall. The display face adds the celebration. Controls stay plain, clearly labelled and familiar.

This app deliberately differs from its parent in three places. Body text is 16px instead of 15px, and buttons are 15px semibold instead of 13px, for legibility. A sticky header with the crest, wordmark and navigation is kept, while kg-eventplan removed its nav. Dark tokens exist, but nothing in this app switches to them.
keyCharacteristics: Ruled, numbered sheet lines instead of task cards or progress bars.
Date-led rows anchored by a large condensed green day numeral.
One green-outlined claim line per sheet. Your own line fills pale green.
A wash time rail for each shift, sticky on desktop and stacked above the tasks on phones.
Flat white ground with 1px green-grey rules and no shadows, overlays included.
For organizers, a date-led event rail beside one event's pane: gaps first, a printable helper list, and inline planning rows.

rules.name: The Green Means Needed Rule
rules.body: Club green marks two things: an action you can take and a place that is still free. Full tasks, past events and filled counts drop to muted.

rules.name: The Pale Is Yours Rule
rules.body: Pale green fill is reserved for things that belong to the viewer, such as your claimed line, your next duty or the "Alles besetzt" all-clear for your event. Other rows are never tinted with it at rest. Short-lived highlights are the only exception: claim-line hover, the highlighted menu or select item, the active mobile nav item and text selection.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Display Rule
rules.body: Every number a helper scans, whether day, time, line number, tally or group size, is set in Barlow Condensed with tabular figures. Words stay in Arial.

rules.name: The Legibility Floor Rule
rules.body: Reading text never drops below 15px, and 12px is used only for short semibold labels. This is the family's deliberate departure for older members.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Separate content with whitespace, rules and tonal fills. No shipped surface carries a box shadow, gradient or blur, and that includes overlays. A raised layer is marked by its border and the scrim. The one gradient is the loading shimmer on placeholder bars, which never rests on real content.

dos: Do keep the crest (`public/logo.png`) and the green-and-white identity shared with kg-eventplan.
Do present staffing as numbered sheet lines, with the first empty line as the green-outlined claim action.
Do set dates, times, line numbers and counts in Barlow Condensed with tabular figures.
Do keep body text at 16px or more, reading text at 15px or more, and every control at least 44px tall.
Do rely on the single global focus rule (3px focus-green outline, 3px offset) and respect reduced motion. All animations and transitions collapse to 0.01ms.
Do name the action in progress on the working button and name the task in toasts.
Do confirm a removal in an alert dialog with "Behalten" focused and a danger "Ja, …" action that names the act.
Do keep overlays flat: white, 1px line border, one radius, the `scrim` behind them.
Do give each route a loading placeholder that mirrors its layout: real rules and rails, shimmer bars for content, a 150ms delay before it appears, and a German `role="status"` label.
Do show one event at a time to organizers, with counts in the display face, and keep the helper list printable.
Do keep creation (events, shifts, tasks, duplicates) in the organizer cockpit, with inline rows first and the full form one link away.
Do build emails from tables, inline styles and Arial, with a table-cell button; never rely on web fonts or CSS a mail client may drop.
donts: Don't turn tasks or events into elevated cards with progress bars.
Don't add box shadows, gradients or blur to any surface, overlays included. The loading shimmer is the only gradient.
Don't use pale green as a resting fill for anything that isn't the viewer's own.
Don't add decorative eyebrows or tracked uppercase kickers. Uppercase is only for date parts and tally status.
Don't add per-component focus rings or `outline-none`.
Don't mark a selected rail or list item with a colored side stripe. Selection is a white fill with a 1px line border.
Don't put a black overlay behind dialogs or sheets. The veil is always the ink-tinted `scrim`.
